target.purpose: Make automated traffic declare bounded purpose and budget through an intent receipt so missing or expired automation authority can be challenged explicitly.
target.central_bottleneck: Automated traffic is difficult to govern when bots are indistinguishable from ordinary users and carry no explicit purpose, budget, or validity window.
success: Intent receipts encode declared automated purpose and budget.
Missing or expired receipts trigger challenge rather than implicit trust.
Receipt validation behavior remains deterministic and auditable.

invariants: automation without a valid intent receipt is not implicitly trusted
expired authority cannot be treated as current
purpose and budget remain explicit receipt properties

donor_plan.basis: The current repository owns the implemented intent-receipt mechanism; no donor implementation is required to define or operate it.
donor_plan.future_extraction: Reusable intent-receipt semantics may be extracted only with lineage, functional/proof equivalence, and preservation of this repository's identity.

nonclaims: reference traffic-governance engineering system, not a production Cloudflare service
